required_before_paper_ranking: Obtain matching RICH TEST data and freeze exact sequence/frame manifest.
Match training-data regime: mixed-training adaptation separate from AMASS-only generalization.
Match CPF vs anatomical-head transform, floor-height source, available body-shape and scene information.
Match 30Hz, 128-frame length, temporal slicing, body-model conversion and 22-joint/root definition.
Run all three models on same manifest using common independently verified metric evaluator.
Report raw and allowed guidance/post-processing variants separately; one-sample and best-of-N must be distinguished.
implementation_audit_notes: Current public EgoAllo/EgoGVAE PA wrappers pass prediction as points_y, label as points_x and output aligned_x, then subtract original label. A pure translation sanity check is required before reusing these wrappers; this observation does not establish how published paper numbers were produced.
EgoGVAE ground metric is lowest-joint height error in mm; original EgoAllo GND is binary ever-touching-ground. They are different metrics.

EgoGVAE GT-contact sliding helper uses four ankle/toe joints, GT displacement <=0.01m/frame and zero-masked mean over all time-feet; this differs from our conditional mean speed on two foot joints at <0.2m/s.
Public helper head translation return uses metres while print label says mm; numeric unit check needed before direct reuse.
Published-table values and public current release are separate evidence sources; no inference that code differences invalidate reported paper results.
